top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows climb to $176M as BTC rebounds above $80K
top_signals.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $286 million over two days, narrowing October’s net outflows to $26 million as the Crypto Fear & Greed Index remained neutral.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Robinhood shares fall as crypto slump weighs on profits, offsetting gains in new businesses
top_signals.summary: Robinhood's third-quarter revenue met expectations, fueled by the company's expansion into options, predictions markets and other financial services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Rio Tinto proposes 56% pay bump for CEO
top_signals.summary: Increase comes after Anglo-Australian group broadened benchmark outside mining sector
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Website used by hackers to leak info shut down, GMO says
top_signals.summary: The internet company has announced a bounty of up to $1 million for information leading to the group's arrest and launched a website to collect leads.
